reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Darren Farber, and this is his second appearance on the show. Darren is a Managing Partner of Albion River. We recorded this conversation in the middle of the Iranian contingency. We discuss why magazine depth matters for the American industrial base, lessons from Ukraine, and what the rise of neo-prime defense companies will require from Congress.
